    pos = observation.get("position", {})
    x = pos.get("x", 0) if isinstance(pos, dict) else 0
    y = pos.get("y", 0) if isinstance(pos, dict) else 0

    # Resource collection: try toward nearest resource if present
    resources = observation.get("resources", [])
    if isinstance(resources, (list, tuple)) and resources:
        # find closest resource
        best = None
        best_dist = float('inf')
        for r in resources:
            rx = r.get("x", 0) if isinstance(r, dict) else 0
            ry = r.get("y", 0) if isinstance(r, dict) else 0
            dx = rx - x
            dy = ry - y
            dist = abs(dx) + abs(dy)
            if dist < best_dist:
                best_dist = dist
                best = (dx, dy)
        if best is not None:
            dx, dy = best
            # clamp to allowed moves
            if -1 <= dx <= 1 and -1 <= dy <= 1:
                return [dx, dy]

    # Pursuit/Evasion: if there are evaders or opponents nearby, move toward center-ish
    foes = observation.get("foes", [])

                move_dy = -1 if dy > 0 else (1 if dy < 0 else 0)
                if -1 <= move_dx <= 1 and -1 <= move_dy <= 1:

        # otherwise move toward closest foe

        if best is not None:
